reviews.title: Temu Style Aggressive Ads - Don't waste your time!
reviews.text: Don't waste your time downloading this app unless you want to be bombarded with pop-up after pop-up and ads. You can't even get to the free trial without any commitment to purchase. I don't know about anyone else, but I wanna know if I like the app before I'm gonna drop any money on it. I was 6 minutes deep and the app was still not showing ANY of the functionality of the app but had already shown me at least 30+ pages of nonsense ads. If there is a good product underneath all that aggressive advertising… I will never know. I just deleted it before I got to my 7th minute.... after such aggressive marketing. The final taste in my mouth was at this company at the very least was going to sell my data, even if I did pay for their app. The marketing was just THAT aggressive. I get enough spam phone calls and junk mail already, no thanks.

reviews.title: Please stop with the “inspirational “ notifications
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app off and on for a few years when I’m working on integrating new habits and I’ve really liked it until recently. In the past week or so it’s started sending me multiple “inspirational “ message notifications per day that feel like they are generated by AI. I find the messages stupid but also disruptive and I’ve gone through the settings backwards and forwards but can find no place to turn them off. I guess I’ll start liking for a new app but am frustrated because I did pay for this app. 🤬

reviews.title: Lack of inclusivity
reviews.text:
I was quite disappointed to see a lack of inclusivity when I clicked the icons tab. I normally prefer them over emojis due to aesthetics. But I noticed a lack of pills/medicine options, pet options, and I also noticed a lack of religious options. There were only Christianity and Judaism. If we go by ‘fastest growing religion logic’ or even abrahamic religions, Islam should have been included as well. But there is no moon and star, no mosques or tasbeehs which would’ve been really cute.

I had intended to use this app for general life alongside health. I have a poor working memory so I wanted to cover all aspects from health to education to my religious betterment and separate my pets additional care I.e alternating meds and my own medication but due to the lacking icons, it doesn’t really appeal to me anymore (I’m really particular about this.)

More so than this, the lack of anything pertaining to Islam makes me feel as though this app has a target audience and excludes me from this audience as using a church does not feel appropriate when I put in a religious habit - whilst it may still be useful for some things, it doesn’t cover everything I had hoped to track.

I would appreciate it if the icons could be updated to include more and to be categorised a little more as the current categories are general and lump quite a lot together. I had paid for premium before noticing this flaw and have been considering cancelling and looking for another app that meets everything due to
